Civil Engineer Job at Paragon Corporate Enterprises




        
    

        
        Paragon Corporate Enterprises is an indigenous company located in Rivers State operating in the FMCG industry.     

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Civil Engineer

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Assisting with site investigations
	Assessing the worth and potential risks of projects
	Developing blueprints using computer-aided design (CAD)
	Liaising with architects, subcontractors, consultants, co-workers and clients
	Ensuring projects meeting legal requirements and health and safety standards
	Resolving design and development problems
	Managing budgets and other project resources
	Attending public meetings to discuss projects
	Using computer modelling software to analyse surveys and mapping data
	Preparing project bids and reports
	Assessing a project’s environmental impact and potential risk
	Monitoring project progress and ensuring it meets legal and health and safety requirements
	Working on-site in all weathers or in an office.

Senior Store Officer Job at JMG Limited




        
    

        
        JMG Limited is a diversified solution provider with a broad portfolio in power generation, electrical infrastructures, and industrial equipment. With over 20 years of experience in Africa and strong partnerships with some of the world’s leading brands, JMG combines global technologies and regional expertise to fulfill the African market's development needs.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Senior Store Officer

JobLocation: Gbagada, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Brief Description
     

            
    




	Plan, coordinate and maintain inventory and supplies by receiving, storing, and delivering items.
	Secure warehouse, implement and maintain all stores and warehouses policies and procedures.


Responsibilities


	Staff Management (No Shortage of Staff at any given point of time).
	Receiving of items from Production (On daily basis - Quantity produced by factory need to be moved 100% to Store under canopy storage).
	Oversee stocks movement inside store, CBU Container Offloading – No demurrage policy.
	Bank Release confirmation need to be sent with in 30 mins of Delivery plan.
	PDI done on daily basis for Min / Max Quantity for each model.
	Responsible for Internal Bad stocks (All stocks should be in good condition).
	Store Management – Inventory Control, follow up for stock taking as per the company norms- Perpetual weekly & Monthly, Cleanliness & Hygiene on floor, Maintaining Stacking Norms. FIFO LIFO as applicable, Fire & Safety standards should be followed, Utilization of available resources, Damage Control, Effective utilization of Space.
	Store Documentation as per the process – (On time GRN’s submission 24HRS, updating bin cards).
	Quarterly – Stock Audit.
	Material handling training for casual loaders / mallams / In house Staffs (Quarterly)
	Warehouse resource planning (Loaders, Forklifts, Pallets trucks etc.)
	Take up IMS responsibilities such as reporting unsafe act, condition or procedure in the workplace, participating in fire or emergency drill at work, participating in incident reporting and investigation when necessary and adherence to Company policies.


Minimum Requirements


	B.Sc in Business Administration, Accounting or equivalent.
	7 -  8 years of proven working experience as a Warehouse/Store Supervisor in a large organization.
	Strong knowledge in stores operation
	Strong knowledge in accounting and bookkeeping
	Ability to input, retrieve and analyze data.
	Strong knowledge and experience on ERP system
	Strong knowledge of inventory, safety methods and procedures
	Proven ability to direct and coordinate operations.
	Strong planning, organizing and time management skills.
	Highly attentive to detail
	Strong communication and reporting skills
	Excellent in meeting deadlines
	Very good problem-solving skills able to deal with complex problems
	Strong leadership skills, able to motivate and inspire team members.
	Goal oriented
	Highly dependable.


Method of Application

IT Female Marketer Job at Uase Tech Studio Limited




        
    

        
        Uase Tech Studio Limited is an innovative technology hub and digital solutions agency based in Abuja. We specialize in software development, graphic design, IT infrastructure support, digital marketing, printing services, and hands-on technical training/coaching. We are dedicated to providing cutting-edge IT solutions and empowering individuals and businesses with modern digital tools.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: IT Female Marketer

Job Location: Kpaduma 1, Asokoro Extension - Abuja  
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description
     

            
    




	Uase Tech Studio Ltd is looking for a vibrant, resourceful, and tech-savvy IT Female Marketer to join our team in Abuja.


Key Responsibilities


	Client Acquisition & Sales: Actively drive studio sales, build client relationships, and promote studio services.
	Marketing & Design: Develop marketing strategies and design visual assets/flyers using software such as Figma, CorelDraw, or Photoshop.
	Digital & Media Management: Manage social media handles, post content, and handle online customer engagement.
	Operations Support: Assist in daily cyber cafe operations, customer service, and computer support.
	Coaching/Teaching: Assist in teaching/coaching students in basic computer skills, Microsoft Office, or introductory design tools.


Qualifications


	 Interested candidates should possess an SSCE with 1-5 years of experience.


Required Skills & Competencies:


	Strong marketing, sales, and communication skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
	Graphic design skills (Figma, CorelDraw, Canva, or Adobe Suite).
	Social media management and basic IT knowledge.
	Ability to learn quickly and adapt to a dynamic tech studio environment.


Perks & Accommodation:


	Optional onsite accommodation is provided (Facilities include bathroom and cooking setup. Stay weekdays, go home weekends).


Salary
N50,000 - N150,000 per month.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and Portfolio to: [email protected] using Job Position as the subject if the mail.

Note


	For more enquires, WhatsApp: 0913 354 9399.
